page.overview:
Who is Tall Order?

Tall Order is a male background Earth pony with a gray (sometimes brown) coat, two-tone pale blue mane and tail, gold eyes, and a varyingly-colored cutie mark of a scroll. He has a speaking role in the season one episode The Cutie Mark Chronicles.__TOC__

Tall Order resembles "Steel Wright", "Brindle Young", S05E12 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #1, and "All Aboard".

Tall Order, along with Dane Tee Dove and Lady Gaval and as well as Surprise and Soarin, was to appear in Friendship is Magic, part 1.

Tall Order later appears with a brown coat during the song Becoming Popular (The Pony Everypony Should Know) in Sweet and Elite. In A Friend in Deed, Tall Order appears with a gray coat and a yellow-papered scroll cutie mark during Smile Song, standing next to Mayor Mare and Lady Gaval.
